references.text: Gibeah is mentioned as a city in the tribe of Benjamin, the same place where the traveling party considers spending the night
Ramah is mentioned as a nearby town, one of the options the servant suggests for lodging
Ramah was Samuel's hometown, the same place mentioned as a possible place to stay overnight
Gibeah was Saul's hometown, the place where the Levite and his group decided to spend the night
The continuation of the story where they actually go to Gibeah and settle there
Gibeah later becomes the site of the terrible event that led to war against Benjamin
